card.name: Words right before prove or be (inadequate)
card.fires_on: A word in the subject or auxiliary slot where the next word is likely a verb such as prove, as in 'this measure' or 'should' before 'prove helpful'. It is strongest on 'measure' in 'If this measure is inadequate'.

modes.label: Referring noun in a conditional
modes.description: A demonstrative or the noun 'measure' after 'if', pointing back to a treatment just described, before 'is inadequate' or 'proves ineffective'.
modes.example: If this<< measure>> is inadequate, shock should first be treated

modes.label: Auxiliary before prove
modes.description: A modal or adverb such as 'should' or 'will' just before a likely 'prove' or 'be useful'.
modes.example: links to a few articles that<< should>> prove helpful for all concerned
